title: De Conditione Mortalis: BLOODBATH/metanoia
description:
A short, creepy, immersive and primordial experience that will bring you underground, in a completely unknown place, full of puzzles to solve, hunted by a ruthless being.

You'll find a lot of metaphoric elements, meaningful details and different, philosophical and psichological interpretations.

Pixeled assets and minimal graphics were used here, precise and curated.

The story is simple, filled with references from movies (Pulp Fiction, Angel Heart, more), music (Dream Theater, Ne Obliviscaris, more) and oriental cultures. 

The game is based on original, interesting, complex puzzles, if you can't solve them, there's a walkthrough online I recorded for you, so that you can go on without getting bored!

I worked hard and really put my soul in this, so...
description_short: Embrace the human condition in this creepy RPG game. Sink in an abyss of loneliness, pain and anguish: will you forge your path out?
